# CitySense Lab: session guide

Act in the role assigned by the current user. A Chief session coordinates bounded work and integration.
Repository documentation and implementation are primary evidence; recover history before alternatives.
Start with [governance index](docs/governance/README.md), then STATUS, charter and relevant contracts.

## Authority and scope
- Current user instructions set session scope. The bootstrap authorizes governance/configuration only.
- The three approved documents are retained byte-for-byte in docs/governance/SOURCES/.
- DECIDED clauses establish direction; PROPOSED, TO VERIFY, TO VALIDATE and DEFERRED retain their meanings.
- Existing ADRs, executable schemas, frozen B0 and protected research protocols remain binding in their domains.
- Consult [precedence and decisions](docs/governance/DECISION_REGISTER.md) and [conflicts](docs/governance/RECONCILIATION.md).
- A conflict blocks the affected contract change until explicit founder approval recorded in a CR/ADR.
- Governance and backlog entries do not authorize implementation or prove capability.

## Product invariants
- November 2026 target: closed supervised Batumi tourist pilot; QR mobile web, no mandatory install.
- Thirty Orbi City A Block apartments are an opportunity; permission, occupancy and participants are unverified.
- Eligibility precedes suitability; unknown required safety/access facts cannot be counted as satisfied.
- Desired default is up to five defensible alternatives; never fabricate a fifth or relax hard constraints.
- Coverage-aware retrieval is required direction; preserve current bounded /v1 search until its extension is approved.
- One backend scorer; no LLM-invented facts. Map/cards/chat/route/actions share request revision and selection.
- Keep verified decision, inferred/self-reported action and provider-confirmed fulfillment separate.
- Scores/weights are unvalidated. Preserve B0, A1/B1 evidence and the protected evaluation protocol.
- Commercial priority stays inactive pending conflict resolution; preserve organic scores/order/hash.
- Booking request is not confirmation; schemas and adapters are not running integrations.
- Batumi only initially. No eSIM activation, driver booking, payments, public agent writes or rollout by implication.
- Source rights, freshness, provenance and uncertainty apply across every client. No remote local_research bypass.

## Ownership and handoff
- Read [Chief workflow](docs/governance/CHIEF_ENGINEER_WORKFLOW.md) and the relevant docs/governance/ROLES/ file.
- Use bounded short-lived subagents for explicitly authorized independent audits or disjoint approved tasks.
- One writer per leased path. Shared models, schemas, migrations and interface semantics require sequential Chief assignment.
- Use [task/handoff template](docs/governance/HANDOFF_TEMPLATE.md); state actual tests and evidence.
- Do not install tools, enable experimental features, contact partners or use credentials without explicit scope.
- Profiles are read-only defaults; portable role instructions apply when native role selection is unavailable.
- Preserve uncommitted user work. Never initialize Git, create worktrees, stage/commit or deploy by assumption.
- Independent QA and required human gates follow integration; implementers cannot accept their own release.

## Stage boundary and next session
- Stage 2 cartography and product implementation are unauthorized in this bootstrap.
- Preserve Sprint 1–3 and Stage 1/1B/1C code and receipts; date current overlays instead of rewriting history.
- Read [status](docs/governance/STATUS.md), [portfolio](docs/governance/PORTFOLIO_BOARD.yaml),
  [interfaces](docs/governance/INTERFACE_REGISTRY.yaml), [risks](docs/governance/RISK_REGISTER.md),
  [backlog](docs/governance/BACKLOG.md) and the current approval record.
- Check actual Git state, active agents and local capabilities before assigning work.
- Stop after governance/configuration review; await founder selection of the next approved ticket.

# Decision register and precedence

Adoption date: 2026-10-10. Accountable decision owner: Founder.
Source: [Blueprint v0.3](SOURCES/CITYSENSE_PRODUCT_BLUEPRINT_v0_3.md), individual ID clauses.
The founder explicitly adopted all three documents as planning direction; adoption preserves each internal status.
The register is an index; exact source clauses and caveats control. Implementation is in STATUS, not this table.

## Precedence by domain

1. Current user instructions delimit authorized actions. Bootstrap scope is governance/configuration only.
2. Founder-approved DECIDED clauses control product intent. Only explicit founder decisions supersede them.
3. Accepted ADRs, executable API/schema semantics and protected research contracts remain binding in their technical/scientific domains.
4. A material conflict blocks the affected contract change until a dated founder-approved CR/ADR resolves it.
   No document wins by silently overriding another; safe unrelated additive documentation may proceed.
5. Code establishes actual behavior; tests and dated receipts establish only the environment/checks they executed.
   Missing implementation or a code/contract mismatch is reported; code alone cannot authorize a new product decision.
6. Governance/backlog/RFC proposals plan future work; they do not prove implementation, permissions or validity.
   Historical plans/receipts remain preserved; current dated status overlays distinguish stale facts.

PROPOSED is not DECIDED. TO VERIFY is feasibility/rights uncertainty; TO VALIDATE is an empirical hypothesis.
DEFERRED does not mean rejected. DECIDED is not IMPLEMENTED; TESTED is not PILOT_VERIFIED.
No numeric commercial equivalence, accuracy, participant count or success threshold has been approved.

# Project charter

Approved direction: [Blueprint v0.3](SOURCES/CITYSENSE_PRODUCT_BLUEPRINT_v0_3.md).
User authorized adoption and this governance bootstrap on 2026-10-10.
The original blueprint's unresolved statuses remain unresolved.

CitySense helps a tourist in Batumi turn an explicit need and essential constraints into a
credible, informed selection through mobile QR entry, comparison and a synchronized map.
The November 30, 2026 target is a supervised closed pilot, contingent on evidence, permissions,
scope and team capacity. Thirty apartments provide a distribution opportunity, not a cohort.

## Narrow pilot outcome

QR/open → need → clarify essential constraints → up to five lawful, defensible alternatives
(or fewer/abstention) → compare/refine → selected place/entrance focus and evidence panel → informed selection.
Routes, contacts and partner requests appear only where separately verified and authorized.
Natural-language input is direction; no approved parsing/model implementation exists.

Known hard constraints precede soft ranking. Unknown required facts do not establish validity.
Sources, freshness, status and caveats remain visible. Do not make empirical accuracy or superiority claims.
V-001/V-006 establish the product outcome; V-002–V-004 metrics/instruments remain proposed.
Keep protected experienced-suitability research and A1/B1 study separate.

## Architecture direction and scope

Preserve the modular monolith, deterministic core, immutable research snapshots and shared service.
PWA, Telegram and later machine clients reuse governed interfaces. Existing private command/demo
and map harnesses are evidence of components, not an integrated tourist product.
Versioned additive boundaries can accommodate place-based, service-area, digital and contact offerings.
Provider adapters cannot bypass source rights, consent, booking authority or suitability policy.

Tours, paid attractions and sports courts are initial commercial segments. November tourist value
must stand alone without offers. A verified information/contact option and any manual request workflow
require distinct readiness gates; payment, eSIM activation, transport reservations, external agent
writes and multi-city rollout are deferred.

## Governance

Founder owns material product, scientific, commercial, privacy, vendor and release decisions.
Chief owns dependency/ownership assignment and integration, subject to accepted contracts.
Logical roles do not create persistent autonomous teams. Implementers do not self-approve.
Use [precedence](DECISION_REGISTER.md), [conflict gates](RECONCILIATION.md) and
[release criteria](RELEASE_GATES.md). No source code, contract or accepted ADR is changed by this charter.
# Chief Engineer orchestration and integration

This operating procedure follows the approved AEOS/bootstrap; product implementation still requires a ticket.

1. Read STATUS, portfolio, decisions, relevant ADRs/contracts and actual Git diff. Check approvals and active agents.
2. Translate the founder request into decision IDs, user outcome and affected interfaces. Record new ideas without executing them.
3. Resolve prerequisites and approval-sensitive contradictions through a CR. Unaffected additive work may continue.
4. Assign one accountable owner and a path lease with ticket ID, base revision, allowed paths and expiry at handoff.
   Shared models, generated schemas, migrations, API semantics, auth policy and central governance have one sequential writer.
5. Give each worker the ticket, its role and necessary contracts. Delegate independent read audits or disjoint authorized writes.
   Default to few workers; this session has four total slots including Chief. Profiles are not a running workforce.
6. Accept a HANDOFF_TEMPLATE response, inspect changed paths against lease, verify actual execution and rights caveats.
   Return incomplete or conflicting handoffs; stop overlapping writes before resolving.
7. Integrate sequentially. Check schema/semantic compatibility, protected hashes and downstream consumers.
   Do not create branches/worktrees, stage/commit or merge unless the authorized task calls for it.
8. Run change-appropriate checks. Use independent QA and security review where impacted; preserve failed/invalid evidence.
   Visual changes need actual lawful screenshots and human review; emulation does not prove physical-device acceptance.
9. Prepare a concrete founder packet: behavior, paths, contracts, tests, screenshots, risks, rollback and unresolved decisions.
   Human acceptance is distinct from integration and tests.
10. Update STATUS, board stage, interface versions, integration evidence and risks. Close ownership leases and record next context.

## Task lifecycle

IDEA_INBOX → TRIAGED → CR_DRAFT → FOUNDER_APPROVED → CONTRACT_READY → TASK_READY
→ IN_PROGRESS → INTEGRATION_REVIEW → QA → HUMAN_ACCEPTED.

Record blocking conditions separately from lifecycle stage; never skip a missing prerequisite.
Minor internal repairs may use a brief scope/acceptance record inside existing authorization.
Material product/science/commercial ranking/privacy/vendor/payment changes require explicit founder decisions.
An urgent security finding may be triaged immediately; urgency does not expand current session authorization.

## Shared-file and interface rule

No producer changes a contract without consumer review, version strategy and acceptance cases.
Chief reserves docs/contracts/, models.py, migrations and shared platform policy for sequential assignment.
Owners listed in ROLES are accountable domains, not blanket permission to edit paths.
New frontend/service paths are unassigned until approved; do not create speculative modules.

## Handoff and recovery

Use ticket IDs and repository artifacts, not whole-chat replay. Give a worker 1–2 pages of scope plus exact dependencies.
On interruption, preserve changes and record lease, pending checks, approval state and safe next action in STATUS.
On restart compare actual HEAD/diff with the handoff base before applying it.
If native roles are unavailable, separate scoped sessions use the same lease and handoff; do not assume they synchronize.

does not establish strict performance; proposed capture directories are not delivered screenshots.

Default role layers are read-only and inherit model settings; runtime parent permissions can override defaults.

## Blocked, proposed and next

Data/rights, QR access, privacy, scope/capacity and map/device acceptance: [risk register](RISK_REGISTER.md).

# Repository reconciliation and founder gates

2026-10-10; read-only scans by Chief, product/contract, service/security and map/QA auditors.
Existing code, protocols, ADRs and receipts remain unchanged. Safe additive governance proceeds.
All options below are proposals; approval is required before the affected contract changes.

## Material conflicts

| ID | Approved direction | Existing protected clause/behavior | Gated recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|
| CF-01 | Blueprint V-001/V-006: constraint-valid informed selection; service satisfaction not primary | docs/evaluation-protocol.md lines 4/10/22: experienced suitability, post-exposure ratings, paired-choice accuracy; docs/architecture.md research goal | Separate named product-pilot protocol from protected research. Approve estimand/instruments/priority; do not rename current evaluation/harness. |
| CF-02 | R-002: disclosed commercial priority among materially equivalent suitable alternatives | docs/OPPORTUNITY_REGISTRY_DESIGN.md lines 46–47 prohibits commission/attribution changing ranking; ADR-0009 boundaries excludes commission from organic ranking; architecture.md | Keep priority inactive. Approve whether a distinct disclosed presentation layer may reorder equivalents; define evidence/tolerance/disclosure. Preserve organic scores/order/hash. |
| CF-03 | R-009: no arbitrary early ID cutoff before suitability | docs/OPENAPI_CONTRACT.md bounds: stable-ID sort, limit ≤30, no cursor; platform.py search ORDER BY p.id LIMIT; ADR-0009 requires /v2 for breaking semantics | Approve additive recommendation retrieval/coverage policy or /v2. Do not repurpose current /v1 search semantics. |

Links: [protected protocol](../evaluation-protocol.md), [opportunity policy](../OPPORTUNITY_REGISTRY_DESIGN.md),
[API](../OPENAPI_CONTRACT.md), [ADR-0009](../adr/0009-agent-first-platform.md),
[platform](../../services/api/src/citysense/platform.py).

## Extension gaps and scope tensions

- CF-04: X-008 service-area/digital proposal cannot use point-required ProviderEntity honestly
  (opportunities.py ProviderEntity requires place_id/city_id/Geometry). Proposed additive versioned contracts,
  no weakened fields/migration. [RFC](SERVICE_PLATFORM_EXTENSION_RFC.md).
- CF-05: R-003 up to five PWA options versus TELEGRAM_DEMO_SPEC three-result private cap.
  Separate channels can coexist; preserve Telegram. Five shortlist does not change exactly-two comparison API.
- CF-06: tourist-first positioning versus agent-first architecture. A tourist client over one shared
  backend is compatible; existing infrastructure does not implement that client. No ADR rewrite.
- CF-07: historical quiet-rest/A1 next-step research priority versus November tourist choice direction.
  Preserve delivery-plan.md and protocol; approve product-pilot task and capacity allocation separately.
- CF-08: append-only research evidence versus future deletion/revocation of restricted partner/personal data.
  Do not store new revocable data there by default; approve retention/archival policy before collection.
- ADR-0009/0010 exclude booking/model parser runtime in their sprint scopes. Future strategic support
  is an extension direction, not current permission to change those boundaries.

## Historical receipts versus present facts

Git now exists: branch stage/1c-map-navigation, HEAD eadf331e4b7c262fb5c2216d051f7f6e56a456bf,
baseline 0e0440a28b2d1c82a70aa545c3e8bf3479e0cea0; no remote output; initial working tree clean.
HEAD adds Stage 1C's nine files. Earlier no-Git/uncommitted statements remain dated history.
No merge/publication or hosted CI success follows. Stage 1D approval/report was not found in repository.
Stage 1C has conditional desktop qualitative acceptance; strict raw measurements and physical mobile remain unverified.

| FA-01 | Separate product protocol and research priority; approve VDCR/TVD definitions, required-criterion audits, denominator/exclusions, comparator and no numeric claims without evidence | CF-01/07; instrumentation and pilot evaluation |
| FA-02 | Choose first tourist tasks/inventory near Orbi, supported constraints/languages, staffing and budget; keep no-data fallback explicit | T-01, T-02; feasible shortlist |

Charter: [PROJECT_CHARTER](PROJECT_CHARTER.md). Target November 30, 2026 is contingent, not a promise.
At most three next engineering tickets are proposed. Reviews/prerequisites below are phases, not extra dispatches.

|---|---|---|
| P0 [T-02 lawful inventory](TICKETS/T-02-INVENTORY.md) | Geospatial Data + Product/Research; FA-02 first tasks, source/provider rights, field access and freshness policy | Reviewed candidate/entrance/constraint coverage manifest; verified vs unknown/stale; publication evidence; no claims of five until supported |

T-01 starts with a contract/readiness phase after explicit authorization. Implementation needs a subsequent
CONTRACT_READY/TASK_READY gate and a Stage 2 authorization if its integration entails Stage 2.
Current Stage 1C code cannot be silently promoted to a production host.
Native roles are read-only defaults; future writer sessions require explicit scoped authorization and path leases.

## Proposed first three weeks after approval

Calendar assumes approval by October 11; shift dates/dependencies if later. Staffing/duration are unverified.
Do not start work because a date passes.

| Window | Dependency-aware proposal | Exit evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Oct 12–18 | Chief obtains FA-01–04/06/07 scope decisions. T-02 inventory and T-03 existing-evidence review may proceed independently if authorized. T-01 phase A scopes shared request/required constraints/retrieval and source/auth boundary. | Named first tasks, honest data coverage/rights, approved privacy/protocol draft, contract/version recommendation; lawful map evidence gap list |
| Oct 19–25 | Complete inventory freshness and visual/device review; resolve retrieval compatibility and freeze consumer contracts. Authorize only a narrow T-01 implementation after readiness and any Stage 2 gate. | Reviewed references/contracts; one lawful end-to-end path, honest fewer/no results, no privileged browser key |
| Oct 26–Nov 1 | Integrate sequentially, exercise stale async responses/refinement/selected geometry and no-data scenarios; independent QA/security plus human physical-mobile/visual acceptance. | Integration matrix evidence, known failures, explicit go/no-go for supervised shakedown |

## November milestones and release dependencies

| Target window | Milestone / predecessor | Gate |
|---|---|---|
| Nov 2–8 | Supervised permissioned shakedown only after data, contract, mobile, privacy and QR permission gates | Founder approves actual rooms/recruitment; proposed 3–5 rollout is not assumed |
| Nov 9–15 | Correct observed failures within approved scope; freeze pilot build/tasks/instrument and support procedure | Independent repeat checks only for changes/failures; versioned evidence and no-go criteria |
| Nov 16–22 | Closed tourist tasks with independently checkable decision evidence and consented minimal events | Actual permission/participants; unknown/unfinished/abstained outcomes included; no superiority claim |
| Nov 23–30 | Decision-quality/efficiency report and founder readiness review; controlled extension only if prior gates pass | State sample/limitations, denominators, costs, incidents; selection/action/fulfillment distinct |

If critical inventory/rights/access/privacy/physical-mobile gates fail, report BLOCKED and reduce scope or
replan with Founder. Never replace missing real evidence with synthetic demonstration or announce pilot success.

## Dependency graph

GOV review → scope/protocol/permissions → T-02 + T-03 → approved shared contract → T-01 integration
→ independent QA/security/human mobile review → closed supervised shakedown → tourist evaluation.

Optional verified contacts depend on actual publication/verification; manual partner request depends additionally
on terms/authority/lifecycle/consent/idempotency/support. Neither blocks standalone tourist selection.
Commercial ordering remains inactive pending CF-02.

Service RFC review and API readiness preserve future extensibility without building a framework.

transport booking, external agent access/writes and multi-city launch require later separate scope/rights decisions.

# T-01 — Narrow integrated tourist selection slice

Owner: Mobile PWA; Platform and Decision own backend seams sequentially.
Review: Geospatial Data, Cartography, Security, independent QA and Founder.
Decision IDs: P-004, G-001, R-001, R-003–006, R-008–010, V-001/V-006, X-003.
Charter: [PROJECT_CHARTER](../PROJECT_CHARTER.md).
User outcome: a tourist can reach an informed, independently checkable selection through one coherent mobile flow.

## Scope and readiness phases

Phase A (only after explicit authorization): define first tasks, approved parsing/clarification behavior,
required constraint vocabulary, wider retrieval/coverage policy, request/selection revision and source/auth boundary.
Resolve CF-01/03 and privacy decisions. Do not claim the current three Need enum values cover tourism/budget/hours.
Freeze producer/consumer schema versions and choose compatibility path before implementation.

Phase B requires a subsequent CONTRACT_READY/TASK_READY decision and explicit implementation authorization.
QR→need/clarify→up to five justified candidates→compare/refine→selected exact supplied geometry/evidence→selection.
Missing evidence means fewer/no results or required clarification; routes/contacts/actions are absent/unavailable
unless independently verified and separately authorized. No partner booking, payment or external agent runtime.
Stage 2 remains prohibited unless separately authorized for the proposed map-host integration.

Proposed owned paths: TBD by Chief after Phase A (no existing production PWA); one writer per assigned frontend/backend area.
Read-only dependencies: frozen engine/parameters/evaluation, /v1 exported schemas, map harnesses, T-02/T-03 artifacts.
Shared models/platform policy/exports reserved for Chief sequential assignment.

Prerequisites: T-02 lawful task inventory, T-03 human visual reference and devices, FA-01/02/03/04/06/07,
approved request/selection/retrieval/constraint contracts, browser-safe auth, no-data support and staffing.
QR exposure/participant instrumentation remain separately consent/permission-gated.

## Acceptance and actual test plan after authorization

- QR opens mobile web without install; no operator key reaches browser.
- Required constraints are explicit; unknown safety/access never counts as satisfied.
- Reviewed retrieval pool precedes shortlist; preserve /v1 compatibility or approved version boundary.
- Five desired, fewer/no candidates honestly explained; no client/model scorer or invented dynamic facts.
- One persistent selection/request revision links cards, map, evidence and supported route/action.
- Card focus uses supplied place/entrance identity; reduced motion and truthful 3D behavior.
- Rapid refinements/out-of-order responses cannot show old candidates, panels or routes.
- Source/time/verified/inferred/unknown/stale/partner status and material caveats stay visible.
- Independently exercise denied rights, missing/stale facts, interrupted network, invalid input and context loss.
- Physical target devices, keyboard/screen-reader and narrow viewport checks plus actual screenshot/human review.
- Proposed VDCR/TVD events only after approved instrument; unfinished/unknown/abstained sessions retained.
- Explicit selection is separate from arrival, fulfillment, satisfaction or causal commercial incrementality.

Evidence: approved contract/readiness record first; later scoped integration tests, lawful actual screenshots,
versioned candidate/evidence decisions and independent QA. No fabricated acceptance threshold.
Open questions: first tasks/languages, intent extraction/model scope, inventory sufficiency, auth, contract version,
Stage 2 authorization, privacy/metric instrument, physical devices and team capacity.

No execution is authorized by this proposed ticket. Use HANDOFF_TEMPLATE and a Chief-assigned base/path lease.
Protected: Sprint 1–3 code/contracts/ADRs/protocol/parameters/migrations, Stage 1/1B/1C evidence and user work.
Rollback: remove/revert only ticket-owned additions or patches after inspecting current diff; never reset unrelated work.
Delivery state: PROPOSED / CR_DRAFT. Founder approval and open prerequisites remain PENDING.

Date: 2026-10-10. Result: **PARTIAL**. Product implementation readiness: **BLOCKED**.
Primary artifact: [ORCHESTRATION_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT](ORCHESTRATION_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.md).

## What was demonstrated

Five real read-only agents inspected one full tourist journey, using six portable role instruction layers.
Chief integrated product, lawful data, map/mobile, API and independent QA seams.
Named native profile loading, enforced filesystem isolation and product runtime acceptance are not claimed.
No product code/approved contract/map stage/feature/deployment changes.

## Decisions requested

| Decision | Concrete proposal / affected gate | Approval status |
|---|---|---|
| Source authority | Provide actual approved v0.4 path and compare its decisions/supersession with current v0.3 register | PENDING; v0.4 not located |
| CF-01 | Separate product-pilot protocol from protected experienced-suitability research; approve criteria/denominator/clocks/privacy before events | PENDING FA-01/04 |
| CF-02 | Keep commercial priority inactive for first slice; later disclosed presentation ordering requires its own equivalence/disclosure CR | PENDING FA-05; no activation |

| Visual process | Adopt explicit review for reference, QR, need, alternatives, comparison/refinement, map/evidence, selection/actions and integrated mobile | PENDING FA-07; no phase accepted |
| Placement/privacy | Confirm rooms/access/recruitment, minimal events/notice/consent, retention/withdrawal and supervised support | PENDING FA-03/04 |
| Next scope | Review the bounded existing T-01 refinement; prerequisites and explicit implementation/map-stage approval must precede execution | PROPOSED / BLOCKED FA-10 |

The report supplies three conflict proposals with options, compatibility and closing evidence.

## Visual material and acceptance limits

No new screens, captures or prototypes were authorized or produced. No actual integrated-journey visual artifacts were located.
Current Stage1C conditional desktop navigation feedback is not approval of all tourist UI phases.
Do not approve missing visuals based on descriptions. Each future phase needs an actual artifact/revision/configuration
and explicit founder record before advancement; runtime map/device acceptance additionally needs physical-device evidence.

Resolve v0.4 and first-task/instrument/privacy/rights choices; complete authorized T-02 and T-03 review prerequisites;
freeze approved retrieval/request/selection and browser-safe access contracts; obtain phase design and any map-stage authorization.

Read AGENTS.md, this packet, the acceptance report and the evidence handoffs.
Verify current Git diff against the recorded base. Record founder answers with affected decision IDs and conditions.
